mapper.insert: insert into system_base.t_system_base_unread_brute_force_captcha_nums (num_code, enterprise_code, unread_num) values (#{recordsModel.numCode}, #{recordsModel.enterpriseCode}, #{recordsModel.unreadNum}) ON CONFLICT (num_code) DO UPDATE SET unread_num = EXCLUDED.unread_num
mapper.select: SELECT id, num_code, enterprise_code, unread_num, update_time, create_time, delete_flag FROM system_base.t_system_base_unread_brute_force_captcha_nums WHERE enterprise_code = #{enterpriseCode} ORDER BY create_time DESC
